data: synchronized executable depth on every leg
spec: Setup: A pool quote and an exchange executable book differ after gas, swap and hedge costs. Entry: Use authorized inventory and a bounded route; reject stale or untrusted pools. blocked_reason: needs prefunded inventory on several venues and synchronized multi-leg execution
